title: Differentiation under the integral sign for the dilation family s ↦ τ(M,θ,ξ)(sⁿω(s·))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient), let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) and t > 0. For s ∈ ℝ put G(s) := R.action(y ↦ sⁿ·ω(s·y)) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(sⁿω(sy)) dHⁿ(y). Then G has derivative at t equal to R.action(y ↦ n·t^{n−1}·ω(t·y) + tⁿ·Dω(t·y)[y]), where Dω(z)[u] = fderiv ℝ ω z u and n·t^{n−1} means (n : ℝ)·t^{n−1} with natural-number exponent n − 1 (so this coefficient is 0 when n = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => R.action (fun y => (s ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (s • y))) (R.action (fun y => ((n : ℝ) * t ^ (n - 1)) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t • y) + (t ^ n) • fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t • y) y)) t
